arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    d.Name AS Department,
    p.LastName,
    eph.Rate,
    e.HireDate,
    MAX(e.HireDate) OVER (PARTITION BY d.Name, eph.Rate) AS LastHireDateInDeptByRate
FROM adventureworks.humanresources.employee e
INNER JOIN adventureworks.humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh 
    ON e.BusinessEntityID = edh.BusinessEntityID
INNER JOIN adventureworks.humanresources.department d 
    ON edh.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID
INNER JOIN adventureworks.humanresources.employeepayhistory eph 
    ON e.BusinessEntityID = eph.BusinessEntityID
INNER JOIN adventureworks.person.person p 
    ON e.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID
WHERE d.Name IN ('Information Services', 'Document Control')
ORDER BY d.Name, eph.Rate, e.HireDate;
